en: The postcard shows a wintry street scene from a European old town. In the background, there's a large, distinct church tower with a green dome and red accents, characteristic of Northern European architecture. The scene includes old buildings with steep gabled roofs, and some people walking with a sled on a snow-covered street. In the top right corner, there is text in Russian and German: 'Старый город.' and 'Alt-Riga.'
